([[Towson, Maryland]]) | college = * [[Towson Tigers men's basketball|Towson]] (2016–2018) * [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston]] (2018–2021) | draft_year = 2021 | years1 = 2021–2022 | team1 = [[Telekom Baskets Bonn]] | years2 = 2022–2023 | team2 = [[Hapoel Gilboa Galil]] | years3 =2023–2024 | team3 = [[BC Rytas|Rytas Vilnius]] | years4 = 2024–present | team4 = [[Derthona Basket]] | highlights = * Second-team All-[[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] (2021) * [[American Athletic Conference|AAC]] Most Improved Player (2021) * [[Lietuvos krepšinio lyga|Lithuanian League]] champion ([[2023–24 LKL season|2024]]) | medal_templates = }} '''Justin Terrell Gorham''' (born August 6, 1998) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Derthona Basket]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA) and the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Towson Tigers men's basketball|Towson Tigers]] and the [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston Cougars]]. ==High school career== Gorham attended [[Calvert Hall College High School]] in [[Towson, Maryland]]. A three-star recruit, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Towson Tigers men's basketball|Towson]].{{cite web |last1=Graham |first1=Glenn |title=Calvert Hall basketball forward Justin Gorham commits to Towson |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/2015/08/03/calvert-hall-basketball-forward-justin-gorham-commits-to-towson/ |website=[[The Baltimore Sun]] |access-date=March 25, 2021 |date=August 3, 2015}} He was drawn to the program in part due to its proximity, allowing him to be close to his father, who had been diagnosed with [[duodenal cancer]].{{cite web |last1=Duarte |first1=Joseph |title=Memories of dad help make University of Houston's Justin Gorham a rebounding machine |url=https://www.houstonchronicle.com/texas-sports-nation/college/article/University-of-Houston-s-Justin-Gorham-driven-by-15939328.php |website=[[Houston Chronicle]] |access-date=March 25, 2021 |date=February 10, 2021}} ==College career== As a freshman at Towson, Gorham averaged 2.8 points and 2.9 rebounds per game. He averaged 9.8 points and 6.7 rebounds per game as a sophomore, despite playing through an ankle sprain.{{cite web |last1=Yanez |first1=Andy |title=Justin Gorham, UH's 'heart and soul', comes to form in senior season |url=http://thedailycougar.com/2021/02/23/justin-gorham-heart-soul/ |website=[[The Daily Cougar]] |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=February 23, 2021}} For his junior season, Gorham transferred to [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston]] and sat out for one year due to transfer rules.{{cite web |last1=Shaffer |first1=Jonas |title=Former Towson forward Justin Gorham (Calvert Hall) transfers to Houston |url=https://www.baltimoresun.com/2018/06/26/former-towson-forward-justin-gorham-calvert-hall-transfers-to-houston/ |website=[[The Baltimore Sun]] |access-date=March 25, 2021 |date=June 26, 2018}} He improved his shooting ability under the guidance of assistant coach Kellen Sampson.{{cite web |last1=Baldwin |first1=Chris |title=The Story of a Jump Shot — How Justin Gorham and Kellen Sampson Worked Together to Retool His Game and Create Something Bigger at Houston |url=https://www.papercitymag.com/culture/sporting-life/justin-gorham-jump-shot-story-kellen-sampson-houston-coach-transformation/ |website=PaperCity Magazine |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=January 7, 2021}} As a junior, Gorham averaged three points and 2.5 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last1=Gardner |first1=Kris |title=Justin Gorham: "I'm just trying to be more consistent." |url=https://www.thehrr.com/Houston_Cougars/mens_basketball/News_and_info/2020/11/11_Justin_Gorham_consistency.html |website=The Houston Roundball Review |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=November 11, 2020}} He became a regular starter in his senior season.{{cite web |last1=St. Croix |first1=Josh |title=College basketball: Houston's Gorham brings father's influence to game against Syracuse |url=https://www.nny360.com/sports/collegesports/college-basketball-houston-s-gorham-brings-father-s-influence-to-game-against-syracuse/article_3cdb0cf1-009d-5aef-b2fd-d843d4b1e84f.html |website=[[Watertown Daily Times]] |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=March 25, 2021}} On January 3, 2021, Gorham posted 11 points and a career-high 19 rebounds in a 74–60 win over [[SMU Mustangs men's basketball|SMU]].{{cite web |last1=Hawkins |first1=Stephen |title=#5 Houston Rebounds with Win at SMU |url=https://uhcougars.com/news/2021/1/3/mens-basketball-no-5-houston-rebounds-from-1st-loss-with-74-60-win-at-smu.aspx |website=University of Houston Athletics |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=January 3, 2021}} He collected Second Team All-[[American Athletic Conference]] (AAC) honors and was named AAC Most Improved Player at the conclusion of the season.{{cite web |last1=Yanez |first1=Andy |title=Quentin Grimes' Co-Player of the Year headlines UH conference awards |url=http://thedailycougar.com/2021/03/10/quentin-grimes-headlines-uh-conference-awards/ |website=[[The Daily Cougar]] |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=March 10, 2021}} Gorham averaged 8.4 points and 8.6 rebounds per game.{{cite web |last1=Womack |first1=Keenan |title=College Basketball Top 25: No. 15 - No. 11 |url=https://texas.rivals.com/news/college-basketball-top-25-no-15-no-11 |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=October 15, 2021 |date=October 12, 2021}} ==Professional career== After his time at [[Towson Tigers men's basketball|Towson]] and [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston]], Gorham signed on July 15, 2021, with [[Telekom Baskets Bonn]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.telekom-baskets-bonn.de/presse/news/artikel/reboundstarker-forward-justin-gorham-verstaerkt-die-baskets.html|title=Reboundstarker Forward Justin Gorham verstärkt die Baskets|date=July 15, 2021|publisher=Telekom Baskets Bonn|language=De|access-date=July 15, 2021}} In 2021-22 he averaged 9.0 points and 5.7 rebounds per game.{{Cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Justin-Gorham/Summary/107333|title=Justin Gorham Player Profile, Houston - RealGM|website=basketball.realgm.com}} On July 21, 2022, Gorham signed with [[Hapoel Gilboa Galil]] of the [[Israeli Basketball Premier League]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.gilboa-galil.co.il/news?NewsId=10957|title=הפורוורד המוכשר ג'אסטין גורהם מגיע לגלבוע גליל|date=July 21, 2022|publisher=Hapoel Gilboa Galil|language=He|access-date=July 25, 2022}} On March 16, 2023, Gorham signed with [[BC Rytas|Rytas Vilnius]] of the [[Lithuanian Basketball League]] (LKL).{{cite web|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba-champions-league/1476370/justin-gorham-rytas-vilnius-basketball-champions-league/|title= Rytas Vilnius officially adds Justin Gorham|publisher=EuroHoops|date=March 16, 2023|access-date=March 18, 2023}} On June 25, 2024, he signed with [[Derthona Basket]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web|url=https://www.derthonabasket.it/justin-gorham-un-campione-di-lituania-per-il-derthona/|title=Justin Gorham: un campione di Lituania per il Derthona|last=|first=|date=June 25,
